in_scope.question: What PWM resolutions are available in phase correct PWM mode?
in_scope.answer: 8, 9 or 10 bit fixed, or 2 to 16 bit set by ICR1/OCR1A

in_scope.question: Which resolutions can Timer1 use in fast PWM mode?
in_scope.answer: 8, 9 or 10 bit fixed, or 2 to 16 bit set by ICR1/OCR1A
